newsitem.title: USA: TCI Internet service offered in Hartford.
newsitem.headline: TCI Internet service offered in Hartford.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Friday its TCI Internet Services unit launched its @Home Network by TCI in the Hartford, Connecticut, area.
@Home Network by TCI, first offered in the San Francisco Bay area, is a high-speed Internet service providing interactive multimedia to a customer's personal computer through existing cable lines.
The service is offered to customers served by TCI Cablevision of Connecticut. Customers are charged $39.95 a month and a one-time installation fee of $150.
